groups.title: For someone else
groups.lede: None of this is a thing you own. Every price here is worked out by an outside evaluator.
groups.footnote: These are modelled averages from GiveWell, not price tags. A cost per life saved carries a wide band, and GiveWell expects every one of these figures to rise over time. GiveDirectly, which simply hands cash to people in extreme poverty, reports that about 89 cents of each dollar reaches the recipient.

groups.title: For your family
groups.lede: The bills that decide what your children get to do, and who looks after your parents.

groups.title: For you
groups.lede: Your own time and your own property, bought outright, with no lender left to pay. Only the tax on it never ends.
